# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price pulls back to VWAP during a bullish EMA ribbon alignment, the confluence of dynamic support (ribbon) and average price (VWAP) offers a high-probability long entry. This edge exists because VWAP acts as intraday fair value, a bullish ribbon indicates underlying trend strength, and a volume surge on the break confirms institutional participation.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger (long):  
- 9 EMA > 20 EMA > 50 EMA (bullish ribbon)  
- Price crosses VWAP from below to above on a candle that closes above VWAP  
- Volume on that candle > 1.3 × the 20‑period average volume  
Enter at the close of the trigger candle.  

Exit:  
- Initial stop: lowest low of the prior 2 candles (chart‑stop)  
- Profit target: 1.5 × risk (R) from entry  
- Runner: after target hit, trail stop at 15% below the highest close since entry  
Regime hints: best when VIX < 18 and time between 09:45‑11:30 EST to avoid noisy open and lunch lull.
